response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), reference AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS overall_avg FROM compliancecase), qualifying AS (SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.avg_modelconf, r.overall_avg FROM status_averages s CROSS JOIN reference r WHERE r.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s.avg_modelconf > r.overall_avg), qualifying_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS mean_qualifying_avg FROM qualifying) SELECT q.brokrepstat, q.avg_modelconf, q.avg_modelconf - q.overall_avg AS above_average_by, q.avg_modelconf / m.mean_qualifying_avg AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying q CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean m WHERE m.mean_qualifying_avg IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The reference average is the mean model confidence across all cases with a value. Cases with NULL brokrepstat form one status group.

alternatives.interpretation: Compare each status average with the unweighted mean of all status averages.
